meta.title: Cerumen removal & cutaneous I&D — clean-room decision tables
meta.derivedFrom: cerumen-id-cleanroom-spec.md (rule numbers cited per row as specRef)

semantics.rowLookup: Rows are evaluated top-down; 'when' is a conjunction of exact-equality tests on declared facts; a fact omitted from 'when' is a wildcard; the FIRST matching row wins; 'output' is opaque data returned to the caller. No expressions, no computation.
semantics.threshold: One integer fact banded into contiguous ranges by 'bands' (min/max inclusive, null = unbounded); the matching band's 'output' is returned.
semantics.unitCaps: Per-code maximum billable units per date of service; caps are absolute inputs to claim assembly, never computed.
semantics.docChecklist: All listed items are required documentation for the code; items are human-verified, not computed.
semantics.payerNotes: Free-text constraints surfaced to the human coder; never evaluated.
semantics.chaining: A matched row/band output whose flags contain 'proceed:<tableId>' transfers evaluation to that table (rowLookup or threshold alike); bare 'proceed' means the next code-emitting rowLookup in document order. An output with no proceed flag settles evaluation: its codes (possibly empty) are the emission.

outputConventions.codes: array of {code, units, modifiers[]} claim lines; empty array = no procedure code (E/M pathway per notes)
outputConventions.flags: blocking or advisory strings the caller must surface; 'blocked:*' means do not emit procedure codes

required: Ear(s) treated (left/right/both)
Impaction finding documented (visual/qualitative/inflammatory/quantitative)
Method documented: irrigation/lavage, solution, cerumenolytic agent if used
Performer and supervision documented
Post-procedure otoscopic check confirming removal / canal status
ICD-10 H61.21/H61.22/H61.23 matching treated ear(s)
Note signed and dated
Ear(s) treated (left/right/both)
Impaction finding documented
Instruments named and visualization/magnification used (otoscope/microscope)
Removal personally performed by physician/QHP and attributed in the note
Time/effort indicating clinician skill was required
Post-removal exam of canal and tympanic membrane, status noted
ICD-10 H61.21/H61.22/H61.23 matching treated ear(s)
Note signed and dated
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: Medicare bilateral 69210: bill one line, one unit, no modifier 50 — claims with -50 are denied. Spec A3.3.
Medicare bilateral 69209: one line, modifier 50, one unit; paid at 150%. Spec A3.2.
Commercial payers vary on bilateral format (single line -50 vs LT/RT lines) — check the payer contract. Spec A3.1.
No automatic claim edit blocks same-ear 69209+69210 or same-day E/M — this engine enforces both. Spec B3.
69210 must be personally performed by the physician/QHP; staff-performed irrigation still supports 69209. Spec A2.5.
Audiologists may not bill 69209/69210 under Medicare. Spec A2.6.
G0268 (Medicare): physician cerumen removal same day as audiologist testing; one unit covers both ears. Spec A6.
Same-day E/M is billable only when separately identifiable, with modifier 25. Spec A4.1.
Always code ear laterality — H61.20 (unspecified ear) is not on the covered-diagnosis list. Spec A5.1.

facts.name: lesion_type
facts.description: Lesion category; abscess_cyst_purulent = the 10060 descriptor list. Spec A7.

facts.name: approach
facts.description: puncture_aspiration = needle only, no incision made. Spec A7.3.

facts.name: lesion_count
facts.description: Distinct lesions treated at this session. Spec A8.2.

facts.name: multiple_incisions
facts.description: More than one incision needed for full drainage (complicating feature). Spec A8.1.

facts.name: loculations_probed
facts.description: Loculations probed/broken up (complicating feature). Spec A8.1.

facts.name: tissue_excision_or_closure
facts.description: Tissue excision, closure, or Z-plasty required (complicating feature). Spec A8.1.

facts.name: same_site_other_procedure
facts.description: Another same-site procedure this encounter, or I&D done for access. Spec A7.6/A7.7.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: Separately identifiable E/M performed and documented. Spec A9.2.

output.note: Same-site/access I&D is not separately reportable.
Aspiration of a post-op wound infection has no clean fit in this family.
One unit per distinct lesion aspirated; never also an I&D code for the same lesion.
Incision of a bulla has no verified mapping.
Multiple abscesses at one session -> 10061, never 10060 x units.

tables.note: Single-lesion band only; any one complicating feature -> complicated (features are consensus — no official definition). Spec open question 1.

required: Site/location of each lesion
Lesion type (abscess/cyst/furuncle vs hematoma/seroma/fluid vs bulla)
Size, characteristics, single vs multiple, depth
Lesion size, location, appearance before drainage; amount and character of drained material
Technique: incision(s) or needle puncture; drainage achieved; irrigation/curettage/probing
Anesthesia used
Culture obtained yes/no
Wound disposition: left open / packed / drain placed / closed
Post-procedure assessment and aftercare instructions
Complicating element stated concretely: packing, drain, multiple incisions, loculations probed, tissue excision/closure — or 2+ distinct lesions drained
Medical necessity for drainage stated (severe pain, infection, or failed conservative measures)
Needle/puncture approach with NO incision
What was aspirated and the volume
Each distinct lesion documented separately if units > 1
Postoperative wound infection of a prior surgical wound identified
Complex work described: suture/staple removal, re-incision, drainage, necrotic tissue excision, packing/drain
Not the same encounter as the surgery that caused the infection

notes: All five codes carry a 10-day global period: routine wound checks and packing care are included. Spec A9.
Bill 10060 with 10061 only for documented distinct lesions, with modifier 59/XS. Spec B7.1.
10160 with 10061/10140 requires distinct lesions plus 59/XS; never aspiration and I&D for the same lesion. Spec B7.2.
Same-day established-patient E/M requires modifier 25 and separately identifiable documentation. Spec B7.3.
Do not bill wound debridement (97597/97598, 11042) with same-site I&D. Spec B7.4.
Ultrasound guidance is not payable with 10140; with the other codes it is payer-dependent. Spec B7.5.
Anesthesia, prep, irrigation, cultures, packing/drain care, and dressings are included — never code separately. Spec A8.4.
Modifier 50 does not apply to these codes; distinct lesions use units or 59/XS lines. Spec B9.
Units above the daily cap deny; 10140/10160/10180 denials are appealable with records. Spec B8.
Repeat I&D of the same site needs a documented reason; more than 2 per year is presumed not necessary. Spec B6.
'Complicated' has no official definition — document the complicating feature explicitly. Spec open question 1.
